def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # line rows/cols: dominated by one non-bg color; find bg = most common
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # horizontal lines: rows where some non-bg color spans wide incl. crossing colors
    # line color per row: the modal non-bg value in the row
    hrows=[]; hcolor={}
    for i in range(h):
        cc=Counter(x for x in g[i] if x!=bg)
        if cc:
            lc,n=cc.most_common(1)[0]
            if n>=w*0.5: hrows.append(i); hcolor[i]=lc
    vcols=[]; vcolor={}
    for j in range(w):
        cc=Counter(g[i][j] for i in range(h) if g[i][j]!=bg)
        if cc:
            lc,n=cc.most_common(1)[0]
            if n>=h*0.5: vcols.append(j); vcolor[j]=lc
    # crossing matrix: special colors at intersections (drop line color)
    M=[[g[i][j] if g[i][j] not in (bg,hcolor[i],vcolor[j]) else bg for j in vcols] for i in hrows]
    # group identical adjacent columns
    cols=[list(c) for c in zip(*M)]
    gs=[[cols[0]]]
    for c in cols[1:]:
        (gs[-1].append(c) if c==gs[-1][-1] else gs.append([c]))
    # compress each group: runs -> keep first len-1 (min1), rest bg; per cell
    def comp(seq):
        res=[]; i=0
        while i<len(seq):
            j=i
            while j<len(seq) and seq[j]==seq[i]: j+=1
            L=j-i; k=max(1,L-1)
            res.extend(seq[i:i+k]); res.extend([bg]*(L-k)); i=j
        return res
    comps=[comp(g_[0]) for g_ in gs]
    Hh=max(len(c) for c in comps)
    Wd=2*len(gs)-1
    O=[[bg]*Wd for _ in range(Hh)]
    for ci,cv in enumerate(comps):
        for ri,vv in enumerate(cv): O[ri][2*ci]=vv
    return O
